cases.name: Helen Litwornia
cases.about: At Mauro, CPA in Somerville, where she had worked for a decade, she was the one who organized the birthday parties and decorated the office. She always greeted clients with a smile and you could see that smile when you talked to her over the phone."She was a beautiful, loving and caring person," said Mike Mauro, head of the firm.
